protocol.description:
This protocol allows a client to register triggerable actions, remaps and keybinds.
This protocol is privileged and should not be exposed to unprivileged clients.

interface.name: hyprland_global_shortcuts_manager_v1
interface.description: This object is a manager which offers requests to create global shortcuts.

entry.name: already_taken
entry.summary: the compositor already has this shortcut registered

request.name: register_shortcut
request.description:
Register a new global shortcut.
A global shortcut is anonymous, meaning the app does not know what key(s) trigger it.
The shortcut's keybinding shall be dealt with by the compositor.
In the case of a duplicate app_id + id combination, the already_taken protocol error is raised.

arg.name: id
arg.summary: a unique id for the shortcut

arg.name: app_id
arg.summary: the app_id of the application requesting the shortcut

arg.name: description
arg.summary: user-readable text describing what the shortcut does.

arg.name: trigger_description
arg.summary: user-readable text describing how to trigger the shortcut for the client to render.

request.name: destroy
request.description: All objects created by the manager will still remain valid, until their appropriate destroy request has been called.

interface.name: hyprland_global_shortcut_v1
interface.description: This object represents a single shortcut.

event.name: pressed
event.description:
The keystroke was pressed.
tv_ values hold the timestamp of the occurrence.

event.name: released
event.description:
The keystroke was released.
tv_ values hold the timestamp of the occurrence.

request.name: destroy

description.summary: delete this object, used or not

request.description: Destroys the shortcut. Can be sent at any time by the client.
